name: OptionsAhoy
description: Multi-year equity-compensation tax optimization. Returns the optimal incentive stock option (ISO) and alternative minimum tax (AMT) exercise schedule, non-qualified stock option (NSO) sell-vs-hold decision, restricted stock unit (RSU) vest plan, single-stock concentration sell-down, protective put and zero-cost collar pricing, Section 1202 qualified small business stock (QSBS) qualification verdict, and a multi-year sell schedule to fund a target after-tax cash amount from equity by a deadline. Each result is globally optimal within the modeled problem constraints, shown against an exhaustive brute-force maximum. The tax math is independently verified against IRS publications and open-source tax engines. Both are recomputed live at https://optionsahoy.com/verification. Covers the full relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC. Remote HTTP MCP at `https://optionsahoy.com/mcp`, no auth, no install. 7 tools.
